content.comment_body: I downloaded the file, but the user count is still limited to 20 instead of 50. There's also no call option available. The current firmware version of my [product_name] is [version_no]. Split from [document].
Apologies, I see now that the firmware version needs to be [version_no] to enable 50 users and the call option. Could you please provide a link to download firmware version [version_no]?
I haven't found a download link for firmware version [version_no] despite searching the [company_name] website. It appears that at this time, version [version_no] is only available on new devices.
Firmware version [version_no] is now available for download. Refer to this topic: Sales and delivery release of firmware [version_no] for [product_name] ([article_no]) including download.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing limitations with their [product_name], as the current firmware version only supports 20 users and lacks the call feature. Upgrading to firmware version [version_no] is identified as necessary for enabling 50 users and additional capabilities. There is some confusion and frustration about where to obtain the updated firmware, affecting user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to support 50 users and include the call feature after upgrading to firmware version [version_no], as mentioned in documentation. They also anticipate an easy process to find and download the required firmware update.
